apiDocsIntro: The NomoSmart external API provides Q&A over published knowledge, SSE streaming responses, citation payloads, and answer feedback. External systems should call the API from a backend service and pass the real end-user identity on every request for authorization, audit, and troubleshooting.
apiDocsAdminNote: API keys are issued by a NomoSmart system administrator in System Management > API Key Management. Before requesting a key, prepare the external system name, use case, owner, email, department, authorized projects, expected traffic, and validity window. The key is shown only once after creation and must be stored securely by the external system.
apiDocsQuickCapabilityBody: Provides Open Responses compatible Q&A (regular and streaming) and answer feedback. It does not provide document management or review actions.
apiDocsQuickBoundaryBody: Only published, serving-ready knowledge in projects authorized to the API key can be queried.
apiDocsQuickKeyBody: Request an Integration Client and API key from the NomoSmart system administrator with purpose, scope, and traffic requirements.
apiDocsQuickFeedbackBody: External systems can mark a specific answer good or bad. Every feedback change is retained as history.
apiDocsOverviewDescription: External systems can use the NomoSmart public API to let existing portals, CRM, service desks, or internal systems query published knowledge and receive auditable citations.
apiDocsOverviewPurpose: Use this API when an external system calls NomoSmart as a system identity while passing the real end-user identity for Q&A.
apiDocsOverviewBoundary: Each request queries one project (set by model). Without nomosmart:scope.document_ids it queries all published, serving-ready content in that project.
apiDocsOverviewNoMutation: The API does not support upload, extraction, review submission, approval, publishing, permission management, or API key lifecycle management.
apiDocsApplicationTitle: API Key request and required preparation
apiDocsApplicationDescription: External systems must request an Integration Client first. A NomoSmart system administrator creates the API key and configures project access, validity, and rate limits.
apiDocsApplicationSystemName: External system name and integration use case, such as CRM Q&A, service-desk assistance, or employee portal search.
apiDocsApplicationPurpose: Expected scenario, query audience, and whether JSON, SSE, or both response modes are required.
apiDocsApplicationOwner: System owner name, contact email, department, and operations contact if different.
apiDocsApplicationScope: NomoSmart projects that should be queryable. Each API call still targets one project_id.
apiDocsApplicationRate: Estimated request volume, peak traffic, and recommended requests-per-minute limit.
apiDocsApplicationLifecycle: Planned valid-from time, expiry time, rotation window, and deactivation contact path.
apiDocsFlowDescription: Treat NomoSmart as a backend knowledge Q&A service. The external system is responsible for storing authorization material, end-user identity, and query audit context.
apiDocsFlowRequestKey: Request an Integration Client and API key from the NomoSmart system administrator, then confirm authorized projects, validity, and rate limits.
apiDocsFlowProject: Set the project in the request body: model is nomosmart:project/<project_id> (the URL carries no project). To narrow the documents, send nomosmart:scope.document_ids.
apiDocsFlowIdentity: Send the employee who actually asked in nomosmart:end_user.employee_id from your backend. employee_name and department are optional and kept for audit.
apiDocsFlowApiMode: Call POST /api/public/v1/responses; add stream: true for progressive rendering. Both return the response id, request id and citations.
apiDocsFlowPersist: Persist nomosmart:request_id, the response id (resp_…), cited documents and error codes for troubleshooting, audit and service-desk review.
apiDocsFlowFeedback: When users rate an answer, call the Feedback API to append good or bad feedback and an optional comment.
apiDocsAuthDescription: External systems call as an Integration Client API key and pass the real end-user identity inside the payload.
apiDocsAuthBearer: Use Authorization: Bearer <api_key> (recommended). If you cannot set the Authorization header, use X-NomoSmart-API-Key instead.
apiDocsAuthHeader: Each request targets exactly one project, and the API key must be authorized for that project.
apiDocsAuthLifecycle: A key that is not yet valid, inactive, expired or revoked returns 401. More than 20 requests per minute (default) with the same invalid key from one source return 429 instead.
apiDocsIdempotency: Idempotency-Key is optional (8-255 visible ASCII characters). With a key, a processed result is kept for 24 hours and resending the same payload returns that same result; a request that fails before the model is called is not kept, so you can retry it with the same key. See Errors for how to retry.
apiDocsJsonDescription: Returns an Open Responses response object: the answer is the output_text in output, citations are url_citation annotations, plus usage and nomosmart: audit fields.
apiDocsJsonProjectScope: Set model to nomosmart:project/<project_id>. Each request targets one project and by default queries all its published serving content.
apiDocsJsonEndUser: nomosmart:end_user.employee_id is required; employee_name and department are optional audit fields.
apiDocsJsonDocumentScope: Optional nomosmart:scope.document_ids narrows the scope; NomoSmart resolves them to the current active published versions.
apiDocsSseDescription: Send stream: true to the same endpoint to receive SSE; the final response matches the non-streaming call.
apiDocsSseParity: Each event name equals the data type and carries an increasing sequence_number.
apiDocsSseEvents: On success the events are, in order: response.created → response.in_progress → response.output_item.added → response.content_part.added → response.output_text.delta (many) → response.output_text.annotation.added (one per citation, after all text) → response.output_text.done → response.content_part.done → response.output_item.done → response.completed.
apiDocsSseTerminal: response.completed means success. On failure you receive an error event (with the error code) followed by response.failed.
apiDocsFeedbackDescription: External systems can submit good or bad feedback for a response id (resp_…), with an optional comment.
apiDocsFeedbackAppendOnly: Feedback never overwrites old records; each update creates a new history event.
apiDocsFeedbackLatest: The UI or reports may show only the latest feedback, while the database keeps full history.
apiDocsFeedbackIdentity: Feedback must come from the same API key and the same employee_id (in end_user.employee_id) that asked; an unknown answer or a different identity always returns 404 public_response_not_found.
apiDocsErrorsDescription: Errors use the Open Responses format: error carries type, code, message and param (the field at fault), plus nomosmart:request_id. Branch on the HTTP status and code, not on the message text.
apiDocsError401: 401 authentication_error: the API key is missing (api_key_required), invalid, inactive, revoked, not yet valid or expired.
apiDocsError403: 403 permission_error: the key is not authorized for this project (integration_project_scope_denied), or a requested document is outside the queryable scope (retrieval_scope_denied).
apiDocsError409: 409 conflict: the project has no serving published version (active_manifest_required), no chat model is configured (model_configuration_required), the same Idempotency-Key was sent with a different payload (idempotency_key_conflict), is still processing (idempotency_key_in_progress) or timed out (idempotency_key_expired), or the stream was interrupted (public_stream_cancelled).
apiDocsError429: 429 too_many_requests: the requests-per-minute limit was exceeded (public_api_rate_limited). This error is not kept for the Idempotency-Key; retry later with the same key.
apiDocsSafetyDescription: The external integration API is a read-only knowledge Q&A interface and does not expand UI management permissions.
apiDocsSafetyPublishedOnly: Only published serving content is queried; inactive, draft, processing, or staging content is excluded.
apiDocsSafetyNoUpload: The external API does not support uploads, data-source sync, review submission, approval, publishing, or permission management.
apiDocsSafetyAudit: NomoSmart records the Integration Client, end user, project, document scope, citations, and request_id.
apiDocsSafetySecrets: Examples use placeholders only; never expose API keys in source code, logs, or browser pages.
apiDocsRetention: Questions, answers, citations, and end-user metadata are encrypted and removed by the configured retention policy. Legal-hold records are skipped.

settingsRetentionHelp: Allowed: 1–3,650 days. Each newly rejected version keeps the deadline set at rejection. Changes affect future rejections only. Expiry removes staging search data while preserving documents and review history. Earlier rejected versions are retained.
settingsTimezoneHelp: Initial time zone for new data-source schedules. It can be overridden when creating a schedule. Existing schedules and directory synchronization remain unchanged.
settingsInvalidInteger: Enter an integer within the stated range; this field cannot be empty.
settingsInvalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as Asia/Taipei or UTC.
settingsCapacityError: This exceeds platform capacity. Ask the deployment administrator to adjust capacity first.
settingsConflictHelp: Your input is preserved. Review the current settings and compare them before deciding which changes to keep.
settingsSaveError: The settings could not be loaded or saved. Check permissions, values and service availability.
settingsUnknownHelp: The save result is unconfirmed, so resubmission is paused. Check current settings and audit records to avoid a duplicate change.
stagingRetentionExpired: Staging search has expired. You can still read the document and review history, or create a new revision.
settingsUseCurrent: Discard input and use current settings
settingsGoDocuments: Open Document processing for uploads, retention and OCR settings
documentProcessingFinalizing: Document processing is still finalizing; submit for review again in a few seconds
apiDocsError400: 400 invalid_request: the request is invalid, for example invalid_model (wrong model format), missing_required_parameter, input_too_long, unsupported_parameter (tools, sampling parameters and similar), instructions_not_supported, store_false_not_supported, context_length_exceeded or invalid_request_body; param names the field.
apiDocsSdkDescription: The endpoint is Open Responses compatible, so SDKs that support the Responses API can call it directly.
apiDocsSdkBaseUrl: Set base_url to https://<host>/api/public/v1 and api_key to the NomoSmart API key.
apiDocsSdkExtensions: Pass nomosmart: fields in extra_body; to retry safely, pass an Idempotency-Key in extra_headers.
apiDocsSdkUnsupported: Single- and multi-turn text Q&A are supported; instructions, tool calling, images, WebSocket and sampling parameters return 400.
chatModeLockedHint: The mode is fixed after the first question; start a new conversation to change it.
chatContextTruncated: Older turns exceeded the limit and were left out.
chatContextRewriteFailed: Rewriting failed; the original question was searched.
chatPreviousNotLatest: This conversation has a newer answer. Reopen it and ask again.
chatConversationModeMismatch: This conversation's mode is fixed. Start a new conversation.
chatPreviousNotFound: The earlier answer to continue from was not found.
apiDocsMultiTurnDescription: Each request chooses single- or multi-turn: omit previous_response_id for a single turn, or send the earlier response id and NomoSmart includes the earlier questions and answers.
apiDocsMultiTurnPrevious: Earlier turns come only from records NomoSmart stored; input still takes one user message and cannot carry assistant answers. You may continue from any earlier response (branching).
apiDocsMultiTurnIdentity: Only successful answers from the same API key, employee_id and project can be continued; anything else returns 404 previous_response_not_found.
apiDocsMultiTurnLimits: Up to the latest 5 turns and 12000 characters (deployment settings); truncation: auto leaves out older turns, disabled returns 400 context_length_exceeded instead.
apiDocsMultiTurnContext: A follow-up is rewritten into a standalone search question; nomosmart:context reports the turns used, whether any were left out and the rewrite. Answers cite only passages found for this turn.
validationScenarioPairRequired: Row {rows}: conversation_key and turn must both be filled or both be empty.
validationScenarioTurnInvalid: Row {rows} (scenario {key}): turn must be a whole number of 1 or more.
validationScenarioTurnsNotConsecutive: Scenario {key} (rows {rows}): turns must run 1, 2, 3 … without gaps.
validationScenarioTooManyTurns: Scenario {key} (rows {rows}): a scenario has at most {max} questions.
validationScenarioScopeDiffers: Scenario {key} (rows {rows}): every row of a scenario needs the same selected_document_ids.
validationBlockedPreviousTurn: The previous question has no answer, so this one was skipped; retry failed questions to run it again.
validationScenarioCsvHelp: Multi-turn scenarios: rows sharing a conversation_key are asked in turn order; leave both empty for single questions.
validationScenarioInvalid: The multi-turn scenarios in the CSV are invalid. Check conversation_key and turn.
apiDocsQuickstartDescription: Use this curl example to check that the API key, project and network are set up. Replace the values in <> and run it.
apiDocsQuickstartStepKey: Have the API key, the NomoSmart host and the project id ready (the project must be authorized for the key).
apiDocsQuickstartStepRun: Run the example. The minimum is model, input and nomosmart:end_user.employee_id.
apiDocsQuickstartStepRead: The answer is in output[0].content[0].text; markers such as [1] and [2] match the citations in annotations. status completed means success.
apiDocsJsonNoAnswer: When nothing relevant is found, nomosmart:answer_status is no_answer and the answer is the fixed text "無法確認，找不到足夠依據。" (no grounded answer found), with no model call and no citations; otherwise it is answered.
apiDocsSseUnknown: Identify events by the type inside data and skip any event type you do not recognize.
apiDocsSseInterrupt: A stream cannot resume where it stopped. After a dropped connection, ask again; if the original request had an Idempotency-Key, use a new key (the same key replays the interrupted result).
apiDocsFeedbackValues: feedback accepts only good or bad; comment is optional, up to 4000 characters.
apiDocsLimitsDescription: A field over its limit returns 400 (an invalid Idempotency-Key returns 422; exceeding the request rate returns 429). Values marked deployment setting can be changed by the administrator.
apiDocsLimitsInput: input: up to 4000 characters; a string or one text message with role user. Images and multiple messages are not accepted.
apiDocsLimitsTopK: nomosmart:top_k: number of cited passages, 1-20, default 5.
apiDocsLimitsMetadata: metadata: up to 16 text pairs, key up to 64 and value up to 512 characters; returned unchanged.
apiDocsLimitsEndUser: nomosmart:end_user: employee_id is required, up to 100 characters; employee_name and department are optional, up to 255 characters each.
apiDocsLimitsIdempotency: Idempotency-Key: 8-255 visible ASCII characters; processed results are kept for 24 hours (deployment setting), and requests that fail before the model is called are not kept. Regular and streaming requests are tracked separately.
apiDocsLimitsRate: The requests-per-minute limit is set when the key is issued; the default is 60. It applies to the key overall and separately to each key and project pair.
apiDocsLimitsHistory: Multi-turn history: the latest 5 turns and 12000 characters (deployment setting).
apiDocsError404: 404 not_found: an authorized project was deactivated or deleted (project_not_found), previous_response_id cannot be continued (previous_response_not_found), or feedback has no matching answer (public_response_not_found).
apiDocsError422: 422 invalid_request: the Idempotency-Key format is invalid (idempotency_key_required).
apiDocsError502: 502 model_error: the model service failed or returned an invalid response; retry later with a new Idempotency-Key.
apiDocsError503: 503 service_unavailable: the service is temporarily unavailable. When the rate limiter cannot be reached (public_api_rate_limit_unavailable), retry with the same key; when the model service cannot be reached (model_provider_unavailable), use a new key.
apiDocsErrorRetry: Retrying: if you received no response at all (for example a timeout), resend with the same Idempotency-Key to get the original result or 409 in progress. Errors raised before the model is called (429, 503 rate limiter, 403, 404, 409 no published version or no chat model, 400 history too long) are not kept; fix the cause and retry with the same key. Failures after the model was called (502, 503 model connection, interrupted stream) are kept and replayed; retry those with a new key. Fix the request or setup before retrying other 400 and 401 errors.

documentTitleInvalidCharacters: Document names can't contain /, \ or control characters, or only spaces and dots.

stationRevisionBody: A new revision starts at station 1 and keeps the current content, chunks, tags, references and vectors. Unchanged stations pass on confirmation without model calls.

stationReopenRequiredError: Return to station 2 before changing chunks.

contentEditStationRevisionRequired: Start a revision to make changes from station 1.

referenceRoutingEnabledHelp: When on, every published-scope question is first checked by the project's Chat model for 'which documents reference X' or 'which documents does X reference'; if so, the linked documents are added from the reference data. Adds one model call per question.
referenceRoutingMaxDocumentsLabel: Documents added for a reference question
referenceRoutingMaxDocumentsHelp: 1–50. Includes the named document itself, ordered by reference count. Applies from the next question.
referenceExpansionEnabledHelp: When on, answers also use chunks of documents linked by references to the search results (published scope only).
referenceExpansionMaxChunksHelp: 0–10; 0 adds none. Applies from the next question.
